features.label: TLS transport
features.doc_help: TLS changes the client transport path; impact depends on cipher and connection churn.

features.label: High availability
features.doc_help: HA mate-link and storage behavior vary; no universal throughput penalty.

features.label: Partitioned queue
features.doc_help: Partition count, keys and consumer parallelism determine the effect.

features.label: Non-exclusive queue
features.doc_help: Non-exclusive access changes consumer distribution, not publish work by a fixed percentage.

features.label: Consumer selectors
features.doc_help: Selector cost depends on expression and how much queued data must be scanned.

features.label: Replay capture
features.doc_help: Replay log capture adds storage work for eligible Guaranteed messages.

features.label: Distributed tracing
features.doc_help: Impact depends on trace sampling, message size and fanout.

features.label: Message expiry
features.doc_help: Max TTL adds per-message state on a queue that respects TTL.

features.label: Dead-message queue handling
features.doc_help: DMQ work occurs when messages become undeliverable or expire.

features.label: Message priority
features.doc_help: Priority affects queues configured to respect message priority.

features.label: Concurrent queue browsing
features.doc_help: A browser only adds work while it actively scans messages.

features.label: Last-value queue
features.doc_help: A last-value queue changes workload semantics; its effect is conditional.

features.label: Local transactions
features.doc_help: Effect depends on transaction batch size and commit rate.

features.label: XA transactions
features.doc_help: XA uses a two-phase commit workflow; compare at a specified batch size.

features.label: DR replication
features.doc_help: Synchronous and asynchronous DR have different limits; link RTT and bandwidth matter.

features.label: Dynamic message routing
features.doc_help: DMR adds forwarding work when there are remote matches.

features.label: Cross-protocol delivery
features.doc_help: Protocol translation depends on ingress and egress protocol and payload type.

features.label: SMF channel compression
features.doc_help: Compression depends on payload compressibility and optimization mode.

features.label: ACL profile rules
features.doc_help: ACL cost depends on the rule set and workload.

features.label: Broker event publishing
features.doc_help: Event publishing matters mainly when subscriptions or clients change.
